title: Certified Sales Manager
overview: In today’s increasingly competitive market, achieving exceptional sales results is challenging. Success requires a modern sales force management system and well-trained sales managers. The Certified Sales Manager course equips frontline sales managers with the skills, knowledge, and tools needed to drive performance and deliver results. It emphasizes key areas such as organization, forecasting, and other competencies to elevate the performance of sales teams.
audience: This course is ideal for sales managers and directors seeking to enhance the performance, productivity, and profitability of their teams. It is also tailored for managers looking to increase their impact on both their sales teams and the organization.
methodology: The course incorporates various case studies, exercises, and group presentations to help participants develop a consistent approach to managing sales teams. Self-assessment tools are also used to build a shared understanding of essential sales management skills.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Exhibit the characteristics of a successful sales manager in today’s market
Design and implement effective sales strategies, organize territories, and apply forecasting models to maximize sales
Evaluate and train their sales teams to boost sales and profitability
Conduct effective sales coaching and counseling sessions
Apply leadership and team-building techniques to improve sales performance and employee retention
Perform thorough sales performance reviews using various evaluation models
